title: HemoVision Feature Schema
description: Specification for the 28-feature quantitative chromatic and morphological feature vector.

features.name: mean_R
features.description: Mean red channel intensity in ROI

features.name: mean_G
features.description: Mean green channel intensity in ROI

features.name: mean_B
features.description: Mean blue channel intensity in ROI

features.name: std_R
features.description: Standard deviation of red channel in ROI

features.name: std_G
features.description: Standard deviation of green channel in ROI

features.name: std_B
features.description: Standard deviation of blue channel in ROI

features.name: mean_RG_ratio
features.description: Ratio of mean red to mean green channel

features.name: mean_RB_ratio
features.description: Ratio of mean red to mean blue channel

features.name: mean_GB_ratio
features.description: Ratio of mean green to mean blue channel

features.name: mean_L
features.description: Mean CIELAB lightness in ROI

features.name: mean_a
features.description: Mean CIELAB a* (green-red chromaticity) in ROI

features.name: mean_b
features.description: Mean CIELAB b* (blue-yellow chromaticity) in ROI

features.name: std_L
features.description: Standard deviation of CIELAB L* in ROI

features.name: std_a
features.description: Standard deviation of CIELAB a* in ROI

features.name: std_b
features.description: Standard deviation of CIELAB b* in ROI

features.name: median_a
features.description: Median CIELAB a* value in ROI

features.name: median_b
features.description: Median CIELAB b* value in ROI

features.name: p10_a
features.description: 10th percentile CIELAB a* in ROI

features.name: p90_a
features.description: 90th percentile CIELAB a* in ROI

features.name: p10_b
features.description: 10th percentile CIELAB b* in ROI

features.name: p90_b
features.description: 90th percentile CIELAB b* in ROI

features.name: mean_hue
features.description: Mean HSV Hue in ROI

features.name: mean_saturation
features.description: Mean HSV Saturation in ROI

features.name: mean_value
features.description: Mean HSV Value in ROI

features.name: texture_mean
features.description: Laplacian texture gradient magnitude mean

features.name: texture_std
features.description: Laplacian texture gradient magnitude std

features.name: ROI_area_ratio
features.description: Ratio of segmented conjunctiva ROI pixels to total image pixels

features.name: specularity_ratio
features.description: Ratio of specular highlight pixels (V > 250, S < 20) in ROI
